extDescription.message: A modern Lichess: a roomy layout, playful pages, your own board, pieces and sounds, and a Debrief for every game.
extDescription.description: The extension's summary, shown in chrome://extensions and on the Chrome Web Store (132 characters at most).

sidebarCollapse.description: The sidebar's toggle, while it shows its labels.

sidebarExpand.description: The sidebar's toggle, while it shows only its icons.

puzzleMenu.description: The puzzle page's cog, which opens the puzzle's details, its theme and the settings.

settingsLink.description: The account menu's link to the extension's settings.

settingsTitle.description: The title of the extension's settings, on the account page.

settingsIntro.message: The extension's settings. They follow you to every browser you sync with your Google account.
settingsIntro.description: Under the title of the extension's settings.

settingUiSounds.description: The setting that turns the extension's interface sounds on and off.

settingUiSoundsBody.message: Little sounds as you use the extension's controls, like the notches of Stockfish's level slider. Lichess's sounds and your pack's don't change.
settingUiSoundsBody.description: What the interface sounds setting covers.

packsTitle.description: The title of the settings' card for the imported packs.

packsBody.message: Your own board, pieces or sounds, from a pack on GitHub. Once imported, pick them in the user menu, in the Extension tab of Board, Piece set or Sound.
packsBody.description: What the packs card is for.

packsEmpty.description: The packs card, before any import.

packsUnreadable.message: The imported packs could not be read.
packsUnreadable.description: The packs card, when the browser's storage fails.

packsPartPieces.description: A pack holds a piece set.

packsRemove.description: The button that removes an imported pack.

packsLink.message: Link to a pack on GitHub
packsLink.description: The placeholder of the field for a pack's link.

packsImport.description: The button that imports a pack.

packsPrivate.description: Opens the field for a private repository's token.

packsToken.description: The placeholder of the token's field.

packsTokenNote.message: A fine-grained token that can only read this repository’s contents, used for this import and never kept.

packsImported.description: Once a pack is imported; $1 is its name.

packsImportFailed.message: The pack could not be imported.
packsImportFailed.description: An import that failed for an unknown reason.

packsNoLink.message: Paste a link to a pack first.
packsNoLink.description: Import pressed with an empty link.

packsHelp.description: The link to the pack format's guide.

appearanceTitle.description: The title of the settings' card for the color scheme and the color themes.

appearanceBody.message: Light or dark, as in Lichess's own Theme menu, and a color theme for each.
appearanceBody.description: What the appearance card is for.

colorSchemeTitle.description: Above the light, dark and system choices; it's Lichess's own Theme preference.

schemeSystem.description: The color scheme that follows the device's.

themesTitle.description: Above the color themes, each with a light and a dark side to pick.

themeForLight.description: A theme's light side, a button; $1 is the theme's name.

themeForDark.description: A theme's dark side, a button; $1 is the theme's name.

themeReimagined.description: The default color theme: neutral greys and a blue accent.

themeLichess.description: A color theme in Lichess's own warm greys and blue.

themeOcean.description: A color theme in sea blues.

themeGrove.description: A color theme in forest greens.

themeEmber.description: A color theme in warm oranges.

themeMidnight.description: A color theme in deep night blues.

schemeToggleToDark.description: The sidebar's light / dark switch, while the page is light.

schemeToggleToLight.description: The sidebar's light / dark switch, while the page is dark.

preferencesButton.description: The sidebar's cog, a link to Lichess's own preferences.

themeRuby.description: A color theme in deep reds.

themeDune.description: A color theme in sand and amber.

themeMatcha.description: A color theme in tea greens.

themeFjord.description: A color theme in cold steel blues.

themeMocha.description: A color theme in coffee browns.

themePlum.description: A color theme in plum magentas.

themeTwilight.description: A color theme of a violet dusk with an orange sun: violet greys, an orange accent.

themeCreate.description: Opens the editor for a new color theme.

themeAdd.description: Opens the field to paste a shared theme's code.

themeCopy.description: A built-in theme's copy button; $1 is its name.

themeEdit.description: A theme of the user's, its edit button; $1 is its name.

themeCopyName.description: The name a copied theme starts with; $1 is the original's.

editorNew.description: The theme editor's title, for a new theme.

editorEdit.description: The theme editor's title, for one of the user's themes.

editorName.description: The label of the theme's name field.

editorUntitled.description: The placeholder of the name field, and the name of a theme saved without one.

editorTint.description: The slider of the hue the backgrounds and greys take.

editorStrength.description: The slider of how much the backgrounds and greys take the tint.

editorAccent.description: The color of links, picks and primary buttons.

editorLowContrast.message: White text is hard to read on this accent: try a deeper one.
editorLowContrast.description: Shown when the accent is too light for the white text of buttons.

editorDeleteConfirm.description: The delete button, after a first click.

editorShare.description: Copies the theme's code, to share it.

editorCopied.description: The share button, once the code is copied.

themeCodePlaceholder.description: The field for a shared theme's code.

themeCodeAdd.description: Adds the theme of the pasted code.

themeCodeInvalid.description: When the pasted text isn't a theme's code.

settingSidebarRating.description: The setting of which speed's rating shows beside the player's name in the sidebar.

settingSidebarRatingBody.message: The rating beside your name. By default, the speed you play the most.
settingSidebarRatingBody.description: What the sidebar rating setting covers.

ratingMostPlayed.description: The default pick: the speed with the most games.

streamersLive.description: The streamers' page: the title of the streamers live.

streamersOffline.description: The streamers' page: the title of the others.

racerTagline.description: Puzzle Racer's home: the scene's title.

racerPitch.message: Solve as many puzzles as you can in 90 seconds, against players from all around the world, or with your friends.
racerPitch.description: Puzzle Racer's home: under the scene's title.

racerStepSame.description: How a race goes: everyone gets the same puzzles.

racerStepSameBody.message: Everyone in the race gets them, and each right move takes your car forward.

racerStepTime.description: How a race goes: its length.

racerStepTimeBody.message: Each right move is a point. The most points at the end wins.

racerStepCombo.description: How a race goes: the combo bar.

racerStepComboBody.message: Right moves in a row fill the combo bar, for bonus points. A wrong move empties it.

racerMore.description: Puzzle Racer's home: the title over links to Puzzle Storm, Puzzle Streak and the puzzle themes.

racerStorm.description: Lichess's Puzzle Storm, by its name.

racerStreak.description: Lichess's Puzzle Streak, by its name.

videosCount.description: The video library's pill beside its title; $1 is how many videos it has.

medalsTitle.description: The title of a profile's medals.

medalPeak.description: The medal for the best settled rating in a speed.

medalStorm.description: The medal for the best Puzzle Storm score.

medalStreak.description: The medal for the best Puzzle Streak score.

medalVariants.description: The medal for variants played (10 games or more each).

medalVeteran.description: The medal for the account's age.

medalMarathon.description: The medal for the hours spent playing.

medalBronze.description: A medal won in bronze, its first step.

medalSilver.description: A medal won in silver, its second step.

medalGold.description: A medal won in gold, its third step.

medalCrystal.description: A medal won in crystal, its last step.

medalLocked.description: A medal's tooltip, before its first step.

medalNext.description: A medal's tooltip; $1 is the next step's count.

medalNew.description: The tag on a medal won since the player last looked.

pdashSolved.description: The share of puzzles solved without a mistake.

pdashPerformance.description: The rating the period's results are worth.

pdashAgainst.description: After a gap such as "−50"; $1 is the average rating of the puzzles.

pdashReplay.description: The button to replay the failed puzzles.

pdashWork.description: The themes the player does worst in, against their level.

pdashStrengths.description: The themes the player does best in, against their level.

pdashTrain.description: A weak theme's link to its puzzles.

pdashKeep.description: A strong theme's link to its puzzles.

pdashByThemeSub.message: Your performance against the puzzles' level, themes with 3 puzzles or more

pdashPuzzles.description: The chart's column of puzzles solved first try, over those played.

pdashFewer.description: Under the chart; $1 is how many themes are left out.

pdashCoachMixed.description: The coach's gist; $1 is the best theme, $2 the worst.

pdashCoachMixedBody.message: You play $2 points above the puzzles' level on $1, and $4 below it on $3: a few $3 puzzles a day would pay off fastest.
pdashCoachMixedBody.description: The coach, after the gist; $1 and $2 are the best theme and its gap, $3 and $4 the worst's.

pdashCoachStrong.description: The coach's gist when no theme is below its level.

pdashCoachStrongBody.message: Your best is $1, $2 points above the puzzles' level. Harder puzzles will keep you climbing.
pdashCoachStrongBody.description: After the gist; $1 is the best theme, $2 its gap.

pdashCoachWeak.description: The coach's gist when no theme is above its level.

pdashCoachWeakBody.message: $1 hurts most, $2 points below the puzzles' level: a few a day would pay off fastest.
pdashCoachWeakBody.description: After the gist; $1 is the worst theme, $2 its gap.

pdashCoachEarly.description: The coach's gist with no theme played 3 times.

pdashCoachEarlyBody.message: Play a few more puzzles and I'll show you where you shine.
pdashCoachEarlyBody.description: After the gist, with too few puzzles.

pdashCoachNext.description: The coach's button to its next tip, for screen readers.

pdashCoachBest.description: A coach tip; $1 is the best theme against its level.

pdashCoachBestBody.message: $1 out of $2 solved first try: look for it in your games, it's where you strike.
pdashCoachBestBody.description: After the tip's gist; $1 puzzles solved first try out of $2.

pdashCoachWorst.description: A coach tip; $1 is the worst theme against its level.

pdashCoachWorstBody.message: Only $1 out of $2 solved first try. Its puzzles are one click away, in the list below.
pdashCoachWorstBody.description: After the tip's gist; $1 puzzles solved first try out of $2.

pdashCoachEasy.description: A coach tip when most puzzles are solved first try.

pdashCoachEasyBody.message: $1% solved first try: harder puzzles would teach you more.
pdashCoachEasyBody.description: After the tip's gist; $1 is the share solved first try.

pdashCoachHard.description: A coach tip when few puzzles are solved first try.

pdashCoachHardBody.message: $1% solved first try: check every reply of your opponent before you move.
pdashCoachHardBody.description: After the tip's gist; $1 is the share solved first try.

pdashCoachReplay.description: A coach tip; $1 is how many failed puzzles wait to be replayed.

pdashCoachReplayBody.message: Going back over a miss is the fastest way to stop missing it.

pdashCoachBack.description: The coach's button back to its previous tip, for screen readers.

pdashSolvedOf.description: The puzzles solved first try, $1, out of those played, $2.

pdashSolvedOver.description: Under "18 of 41"; $1 is the period, as "30 days".

pdashBest.description: The theme the player does best in, against its level.

pdashBestAgainst.description: After the best theme's gap, as "+500".

pdashFailedOne.message: puzzle failed and not solved since
pdashFailedOne.description: After a count of 1, in the numbers card's foot.

pdashFailed.message: puzzles failed and not solved since
pdashFailed.description: After a count of puzzles to replay, in the numbers card's foot.

pdashAllClear.message: Nothing to replay: every miss has been solved since.
pdashAllClear.description: The numbers card's foot when no puzzle waits to be replayed.

pdashStartHere.description: Over the first improvement area, the one to work on first.

pdashTrainNow.description: The first improvement area's link to its puzzles.

pdashKeepSharp.description: The first strength's link to its puzzles.

pdashThenThese.description: The title over the other improvement areas.

pdashAlsoStrong.description: The title over the other strengths.

pdashFactPerformance.description: Under a theme's performance, before its gap.

pdashFactLevel.description: Under the average rating of a theme's puzzles.

pdashFactPlayed.description: Under the number of a theme's puzzles played.

pdashReplayCount.description: A theme's link to its failed puzzles; $1 is how many.
